provenance.note: Zigbee2MQTT exposes these as contact (true = closed) and battery; the bridge's zigbee2mqtt driver maps by property name, the cluster ids here are the underlying ZCL facts.

source: Zigbee Cluster Library specification: IAS Zone (0x0500) zone status bit 1 (alarm2 is commonly contact on door sensors; vendors expose it as contact via Zigbee2MQTT 'contact' property) and Power Configuration (0x0001).
